english: He who has wisdom has patience.
arabic: من كان له عقلٌ كان له صبر.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

circassian: Акъылым уасэ иӀэкъым, гъэсэныгъэм гъунэ иӀэкъым
latin: Aqılım wase i'eqım, ghesenıghem ghune i'eqım
english: Wisdom has no price, and good upbringing has no limit.
arabic: العقل لا ثمن له، والتربية لا حدَّ لها.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Measure seven times, cut once.
arabic: قِسْ سبع مرات واقطع مرة واحدة.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Praise the old, and take up the new.
arabic: امدح القديم وخذ الجديد.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Better wisdom beforehand than wisdom afterwards.
arabic: حكمةٌ قبل الأمر خيرٌ من حكمةٍ بعده.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: He who has seen much knows much.
arabic: من رأى كثيرًا عرف كثيرًا.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Better to write with the mind than with the pen.
arabic: أن تكتب بعقلك خيرٌ من أن تكتب بقلمك.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Begin a task without thinking, and you will go wrong.
arabic: إن بدأت عملًا بلا تفكير أخطأت.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: If you seek counsel, you will not go wrong.
arabic: من استشار لم يخطئ.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: He who has no knowledge is like the blind.
arabic: من لا علم له كالأعمى.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Wisdom is wealth.
arabic: العقل ثروة.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Wisdom is not a matter of being old or young.
arabic: العقل ليس بالكِبَر ولا بالصِّغَر.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Two minds are better than one.
arabic: عقلان خيرٌ من عقلٍ واحد.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

circassian: Бажэм я нэхъ Ӏущыр и гъуэм щаубыд
latin: Bazhem ya nekh 'uschır i ghwem schaubıd
english: Even the cleverest of foxes is caught at its own den.
arabic: أذكى الثعالب يُصاد عند جُحره.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

circassian: Губзыгъэм и гуӀэгъуэр делэм и гуфӀэгъуэщ
latin: Gubzıghem i gu'eghwer délem i guf'eghwesch
english: The wise man's sorrow is the fool's joy.
arabic: حزن العاقل فرحُ الأحمق.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: The fool grows old still hoping.
arabic: الأحمق يشيخ وهو يتمنّى.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Knowledge and craft are brothers.
arabic: العلم والصنعة أخوان.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Wisdom is the root of the deed.
arabic: العقل أصلُ العمل.
source: Çerkes Atasözleri [Адыгэ ГущыӀэжъхэр-Псалъэжьхэр] (academia.edu excerpt)

english: Wisdom does not wait for the beard.
arabic: العقل لا ينتظر اللحية.
source: Çerkes Atasözleri [Адыгэ ГущыӀэжъхэр-Псалъэжьхэр] (academia.edu excerpt)

english: Wisdom is not sold and not bought; it is planted within.
arabic: العقل لا يُباع ولا يُشترى، بل يُغرَس في النفس.
source: Çerkes Atasözleri [Адыгэ ГущыӀэжъхэр-Псалъэжьхэр] (academia.edu excerpt)

english: Wisdom is wealth; wealth is dew.
arabic: العقل ثروة، والثروة ندى.
source: Çerkes Atasözleri [Адыгэ ГущыӀэжъхэр-Псалъэжьхэр] (academia.edu excerpt)

english: Wisdom is the root of every deed.
arabic: العقل أصلُ كل عمل.
source: Çerkes Atasözleri [Адыгэ ГущыӀэжъхэр-Псалъэжьхэр] (academia.edu excerpt)

english: Wisdom is not tied to the beard.
arabic: العقل ليس معلَّقًا باللحية.
source: Çerkes Atasözleri [Адыгэ ГущыӀэжъхэр-Псалъэжьхэр] (academia.edu excerpt)

english: Wisdom seeks; fortune finds.
arabic: العقل يبحث، والحظ يجد.
source: Çerkes Atasözleri [Адыгэ ГущыӀэжъхэр-Псалъэжьхэр] (academia.edu excerpt)

english: Wisdom cannot be bought with wealth.
arabic: العقل لا يُشترى بالمال.
source: Çerkes Atasözleri [Адыгэ ГущыӀэжъхэр-Псалъэжьхэр] (academia.edu excerpt)

english: Of all possessions, wisdom is the most precious.
arabic: العقل أغلى الممتلكات.
source: Çerkes Atasözleri [Адыгэ ГущыӀэжъхэр-Псалъэжьхэр] (academia.edu excerpt)

english: Wisdom makes the face shine.
arabic: العقل يضيء الوجه.
source: Çerkes Atasözleri [Адыгэ ГущыӀэжъхэр-Псалъэжьхэр] (academia.edu excerpt)

english: Knowledge is never too much.
arabic: العلم لا يكون زائدًا.
source: Адыгабзэ school textbook / teacher's guide, grade 3 (online excerpt)

english: The book is the key to knowledge.
arabic: الكتاب مفتاح العلم.
source: Адыгабзэ school textbook / teacher's guide, grade 3 (online excerpt)

english: Knowledge is the most precious of all wealth.
arabic: العلم أغلى الثروات كلها.
source: Адыгабзэ school textbook / teacher's guide, grade 3 (online excerpt)

english: He who has no wisdom is the truly poor one.
arabic: من لا عقل له هو المسكين حقًّا.
source: Адыгабзэ school textbook / teacher's guide, grade 3 (online excerpt)

english: The tongue is sharper than the sword.
arabic: اللسان أحدُّ من السيف.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Think, then speak; look around, then sit.
arabic: فكِّر ثم تكلَّم، وانظر حولك ثم اجلس.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

circassian: Зым и щэхур щэхущи, тӀум я щэхур нахуэщ
latin: Zım i schexur schexuschi, t'um ya schexur naxwesch
english: One person's secret is a secret; two people's secret is public.
arabic: سرُّ الواحد سرّ، وسرُّ الاثنين علانية.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

circassian: КӀапсэр кӀыхьмэ, фӀыщи, псалъэр кӀэщӀмэ, нэхъыфӀыжщ
latin: K'apser k'ıhme, f'ıschi, psalher k'esch'me, nekhıf'ızhsch
english: A rope is good when it is long; a speech is better still when it is short.
arabic: الحبل خيرُه في طوله، والكلام خيرُه في قِصَره.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)
other_dialect_form: КӀапсэр кӀыхьэмэ дэгъу, гущыӀэр кӀэкӀымэ нахьышӀу

english: As long as he keeps silent, even the fool is wise.
arabic: ما دام صامتًا فالأحمق أيضًا حكيم.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: A soft word softens the heart.
arabic: الكلمة الليّنة تليِّن القلب.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: What is said arrives; what is sown grows.
arabic: ما يُقال يصل، وما يُزرع ينبت.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: For a kind word you pay nothing.
arabic: الكلمة الطيبة لا تكلِّفك شيئًا.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: The tongue is the heart's interpreter.
arabic: اللسان ترجمان القلب.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: The tongue is swifter than the bullet.
arabic: اللسان أسرع من الرصاصة.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: What lies in the heart, the mouth speaks.
arabic: ما في القلب يقوله الفم.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

circassian: Джатэ жаным иуӀар мэхъужри, псалъэ жагъуэм иуӀар хъужыркъым
latin: Jate zhanım iu'ar mekhuzhri, psalhe zhaghwem iu'ar khuzhırqım
english: The wound of a sharp sword heals; the wound of a hurtful word does not.
arabic: جرح السيف الحادّ يبرأ، وجرح الكلمة الجارحة لا يبرأ.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: If the baby does not cry, it is not given the breast.
arabic: إن لم يبكِ الرضيع لم يُعطَ الثدي.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: There is no one without some secret.
arabic: ما من أحدٍ إلا وله سرّ.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: He who can make a hundred listen is worth a hundred.
arabic: من استطاع أن يُسمِع مئةً فهو يساوي مئة.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

circassian: УмэжалӀэкӀэ къыппэщӀэхуэр иумыгуэ, узэгуэпкӀэ къыбжьэдэхуэр жумыӀэ
latin: Umezhal'ek'e qıppesch'exwer iumıgwe, uzegwepk'e qıbzchedexwer zhumı'e
english: When hungry, do not swallow whatever comes to hand; when angry, do not say whatever comes to your tongue.
arabic: إذا جعت فلا تأكل كل ما يقع في يدك، وإذا غضبت فلا تقل كل ما يخطر على لسانك.
source: Khazhirokova, article on ethical stereotypes in Adyghe proverbs (interactive-plus.ru)

english: Make your word precious.
arabic: اجعل كلمتك غالية.
source: Khazhirokova, article on ethical stereotypes in Adyghe proverbs (interactive-plus.ru)

circassian: Уи псалъэ гъэӀэси уи нэмыс гъэбыдэ
latin: Wi psalhe ghe'esi wi nemıs ghebıde
english: Hone your word and fortify your honour.
arabic: هذِّب كلمتك وحصِّن أدبك.
source: Khazhirokova, article on ethical stereotypes in Adyghe proverbs (interactive-plus.ru)

circassian: ПщӀэ псор жумыӀэ, жаӀэ псор зэгъащӀэ
latin: Psch'e psor zhumı'e, zha'e psor zeghasch'e
english: Do not say all that you know; learn all that is said.
arabic: لا تقل كل ما تعرف، وتعلَّم كل ما يُقال.
source: Khazhirokova, article on ethical stereotypes in Adyghe proverbs (interactive-plus.ru)
other_dialect_form: ПшӀэрэ пстэури къэмыӀу, къаӀорэ пстэури зэгъашӀэ

circassian: Зи псалъэ кӀэщӀым и бзэр ӀэфӀщ
english: He whose speech is short has a sweet tongue.
arabic: من قصُر كلامه حلا لسانه.
source: Khazhirokova, article on ethical stereotypes in Adyghe proverbs (interactive-plus.ru)

english: However much you feed the wolf, it still looks toward the forest.
arabic: مهما أطعمتَ الذئب يبقَ ناظرًا إلى الغابة.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Adyghe Xabze is the inheritance our fathers left us.
arabic: الأديغة خابزة ميراثُ الآباء.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Better the one who gives than the one who is given.
arabic: المعطي خيرٌ من الآخذ.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

circassian: Зи мыӀуэху зезыхуэм и щхьэм баш техуэнщ
latin: Zi mı'wexu zézıxwem i schhem bash téxwensch
english: He who meddles in what is not his business will take a stick on the head.
arabic: من تدخَّل في ما لا يعنيه نالت رأسَه العصا.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: A man does not go back on his word.
arabic: الرجل لا ينكث كلمته.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

circassian: ЛӀыфӀыр бэ дыдэщи, лӀыфӀ дыдэр зырызщ
latin: L'ıf'ır be dıdeschi, l'ıf' dıder zırızsch
english: Good men are many; truly good men are few.
arabic: الرجال الطيبون كثير، والطيبون حقًّا قليل.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)
other_dialect_form: ЛӀы фэдэр бэ дэд, лӀы дэдэр зырыз

english: Where there is no nemis (decorum and respect), there is no happiness either.
arabic: حيث لا أدب ولا احترام، لا سعادة.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

circassian: Уи щхьэм пщӀэ хуумыщӀыжмэ, зыми къыпхуищӀынкъым
latin: Wi schhem psch'e xuumısch'ızhme, zımi qıpxwisch'ınqım
english: If you do not respect yourself, no one will respect you.
arabic: إن لم تحترم نفسك فلن يحترمك أحد.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: When the snake swells up, it no longer fits in its hole.
arabic: إذا انتفخت الأفعى لم يسعها جُحرها.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Beauty hides a hundred flaws.
arabic: الجمال يخفي مئة عيب.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

circassian: Нэхъыжьым жьэ ет, нэхъыщӀэм гъуэгу ет
latin: Nekhızchım zche yet, nekhısch'em ghwegu yet
english: Give the elder the word; give the younger the road.
arabic: أعطِ الكبيرَ الكلمة، وأعطِ الصغيرَ الطريق.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Do not kill a dog in the water you will drink.
arabic: لا تقتل كلبًا في الماء الذي ستشرب منه.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: When the wicked man flatters, he wants something.
arabic: إذا تملَّق الخبيث فهو يريد شيئًا.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: What lies in the heart, the face lets you know.
arabic: ما في القلب يُظهره الوجه.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: No one becomes a great thief without starting as a small one.
arabic: لا يصير أحدٌ لصًّا كبيرًا إلا إذا بدأ لصًّا صغيرًا.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: He who cannot dance blames the accordion player.
arabic: من لا يحسن الرقص يلوم العازف.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Excess is folly.
arabic: الإفراط حماقة.
source: Khazhirokova, article on ethical stereotypes in Adyghe proverbs (interactive-plus.ru)

english: Do not strain for the seat of honour; if you deserve it, it will come to you.
arabic: لا تسعَ إلى صدر المجلس؛ إن كنت أهلًا له جاءك.
source: Khazhirokova, article on ethical stereotypes in Adyghe proverbs (interactive-plus.ru)

circassian: УлӀмэ, уи щхьэ ущымытхъу – уфӀмэ жылэр къыпщытхъунщ
latin: Ul'me, wi schhe uschımıtkhu – uf'me zhıler qıpschıtkhunsch
english: If you are a man, do not praise yourself; if you are good, the people will praise you.
arabic: إن كنت رجلًا فلا تمدح نفسك؛ إن كنت صالحًا مدحك الناس.
source: Khazhirokova, article on ethical stereotypes in Adyghe proverbs (interactive-plus.ru)
other_dialect_form: УлӀымэ, пшъхьэ ущымытхъу, ушӀумэ, чылэр къыпщытхъун

english: A man does not recount what he has done.
arabic: الرجل لا يحدِّث بما فعل.
source: Khazhirokova, article on ethical stereotypes in Adyghe proverbs (interactive-plus.ru)

english: Even if the one who calls you is younger, turn back to him.
arabic: وإن كان مناديك أصغر منك فالتفت إليه.
source: Khazhirokova, article on ethical stereotypes in Adyghe proverbs (interactive-plus.ru)

english: Honour before life.
arabic: الشرف قبل الروح.
source: Wikipedia, 'Circassia' (national motto)

english: If you fear wolves, do not go into the forest.
arabic: إن كنت تخاف الذئاب فلا تدخل الغابة.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Even a mouse is a hero in its own hole.
arabic: حتى الفأر بطلٌ في جُحره.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: There is no playing at war, and no playing at quarrels.
arabic: لا لعبَ في الحرب ولا لعبَ في الخصام.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: The end of war is mourning.
arabic: آخر الحرب مأتم.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: There is no good war and no good quarrel.
arabic: لا حربَ حسنةٌ ولا خصامَ حسن.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: The coward takes fright at his own tail.
arabic: الجبان يفزع من ذيله.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: The coward dies twice.
arabic: الجبان يموت مرتين.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

circassian: УэфӀым и ужьыр уэлбанэщ, зауэм и ужьыр хьэдагъэщ
latin: Wef'ım i uzchır welbanesch, zawem i uzchır hedaghesch
english: After fair weather comes the rain; after war comes mourning.
arabic: بعد الصحو يأتي المطر، وبعد الحرب يأتي المأتم.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Everyone is a hero in his own house.
arabic: كلٌّ بطلٌ في بيته.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Quick to panic, quick to ruin.
arabic: سريعُ الذعر سريعُ الهلاك.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Either be a man, or die.
arabic: إمّا أن تكون رجلًا وإمّا أن تموت.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: A hero's trace is never lost.
arabic: أثر البطل لا يضيع.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: From beneath a shaggy old cloak a hero may step out.
arabic: من تحت العباءة البالية قد يخرج بطل.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: He who cannot bear hardship is not counted among men.
arabic: من لا يحتمل المشقّة لا يُعَدُّ من الرجال.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: If you are a dagger, I am a sword.
arabic: إن كنتَ خنجرًا فأنا سيف.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: The deer returns to the place where it was born.
arabic: يعود الأيل إلى حيث وُلد.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

circassian: Хамэ хэку сыщытхъэ нэхъ си хэкужь сыщылӀэ
latin: Xame xeku sıschıtkhe nekh si xekuzch sıschıl'e
english: Better to die in my own old homeland than to live in plenty in a foreign land.
arabic: أن أموت في وطني القديم خيرٌ من أن أنعم في بلاد الغربة.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)
other_dialect_form: Хымэ хэку сыщытхъэн нахьи сихэкужъ сыщэрэлӀ

english: The stray dog comes in and drives out the dog of the house.
arabic: يدخل الكلب الغريب فيطرد كلب الدار.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: He who has no homeland never thrives.
arabic: من لا وطن له لا يهنأ.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: To the Circassian, the guest is beloved.
arabic: الضيف عزيزٌ على الشركسي.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: However poor the Circassian, there is salt and pasta (millet bread) for the guest.
arabic: مهما افتقر الشركسي فعنده للضيف ملحٌ وباستا (خبز الدخن).
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

circassian: Биижь благъэ хъуркъым, благъэжь бий хъуркъым
latin: Biizch blaghe khurqım, blaghezch biy khurqım
english: An old enemy does not become kin, and old kin does not become an enemy.
arabic: العدو القديم لا يصير قريبًا، والقريب القديم لا يصير عدوًّا.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)
other_dialect_form: Блэгъэжъыр пыижъ хъурэп, пыижъыр блэгъэжъ хъурэп

english: Better a good neighbour than a distant relative.
arabic: جارٌ طيب خيرٌ من قريبٍ بعيد.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Better a wise enemy than a foolish kinsman.
arabic: عدوٌّ عاقل خيرٌ من قريبٍ أحمق.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: There is no one who has neither ill-wishers nor well-wishers.
arabic: ما من أحدٍ إلا وله مبغضون ومحبّون.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Better a good friend than a bad brother.
arabic: صديقٌ صالح خيرٌ من أخٍ سيّئ.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

circassian: Ныбжьэгъум занщӀэу къыбжиӀэнщ, бийм уи щӀыбкӀэ щигъэӀунщ
latin: Nıbzcheghum zansch'eu qıbzhi'ensch, biym wi sch'ıbk'e schighe'unsch
english: A friend will say it straight to your face; an enemy will spread it behind your back.
arabic: الصديق يقولها لك في وجهك، والعدو يذيعها من وراء ظهرك.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)
other_dialect_form: Ныбджэгъум занкӀэу къыуеӀо, пыим уакӀыбыкӀэ щеӀо

english: Better an open enemy than a false friend.
arabic: عدوٌّ ظاهر خيرٌ من صديقٍ زائف.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

circassian: Ныбжьэгъур уи нэгу къыщӀоплъэ, жагъуэгъур уи лъакъуэ йоплъых
latin: Nıbzcheghur wi negu qısch'oplhe, zhaghweghur wi lhaqwe yoplhıx
english: A friend looks you in the face; an ill-wisher looks down at your feet.
arabic: الصديق ينظر في وجهك، والمبغض ينظر إلى قدميك.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)
other_dialect_form: Узиджагъор плъакъо къеплъы, узикӀасэр пшъхьэ къеплъы

english: A friend is a mirror.
arabic: الصديق مرآة.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Parting is born of anger.
arabic: الفراق يولد من الغضب.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Hardship is where friends are told apart.
arabic: الشدّة موضعُ تمييز الأصدقاء.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

circassian: ӀитӀкӀэ уи Ӏэр зыубыдыр уи щӀыб щопсэлъэж
english: He who clasps your hand in both of his talks behind your back.
arabic: من يصافحك بكلتا يديه يتكلّم من وراء ظهرك.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: A good horse is like a good friend.
arabic: الحصان الجيد كالصديق الجيد.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

circassian: Уи благъэ уемыпэгэкӀ – уи бийм благъэ хуэхъунщ
latin: Wi blaghe wyemıpegek' – wi biym blaghe xwekhunsch
english: Do not look down on your kinsman, or he will become kin to your enemy.
arabic: لا تتكبّر على قريبك فيصير قريبًا لعدوّك.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Not all brothers are born of one mother.
arabic: ليس كل الإخوة من أمٍّ واحدة.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

circassian: ЗэлӀзэфыз я псэ зы чысэ илъщ
latin: Zel'zefız ya pse zı chıse ilhsch
english: Husband and wife keep their souls in one pouch.
arabic: روحا الزوجين في كيسٍ واحد.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: He who has no brother embraces a stick.
arabic: من لا أخ له يعانق العصا.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: There is no such thing as one brother too many.
arabic: ليس هناك أخٌ زائد.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

circassian: Зи адэ лӀар ибэ ныкъуэщ, зи анэ лӀар ибэ хъурейщ
latin: Zi ade l'ar ibe nıqwesch, zi ane l'ar ibe khuréysch
english: He whose father has died is half an orphan; he whose mother has died is an orphan entire.
arabic: من مات أبوه فهو نصف يتيم، ومن ماتت أمه فهو يتيمٌ كامل.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

circassian: Уи адэр фӀамэ, уэ уи щытхъукъым, къуэфӀ упӀамэ, къыпщытхъунщ
latin: Wi ader f'ame, we wi schıtkhuqım, qwef' up'ame, qıpschıtkhunsch
english: If your father was a good man, that is no praise of you; raise a good son, and you will be praised.
arabic: إن كان أبوك صالحًا فليس ذلك مدحًا لك؛ ربِّ ابنًا صالحًا تُمدَح.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

circassian: Къомыхъуэжынур, къомыщэжынур уи анэрэ уи нитӀрэщ
latin: Qomıkhwezhınur, qomıschezhınur wi anere wi nit'resch
english: What you can never replace and never buy back: your mother and your two eyes.
arabic: ما لا يُستبدل ولا يُشترى: أمُّك وعيناك.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

circassian: Фыз дахэ тхьэмахуэ фызщи, фызыфӀ ныбжьырей фызщ
latin: Fız daxe themaxwe fızschi, fızıf' nıbzchıréy fızsch
english: A beautiful wife is a wife for a week; a good wife is a wife for a lifetime.
arabic: الزوجة الجميلة زوجةُ أسبوع، والزوجة الصالحة زوجةُ العمر.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Better a blind sister than no sister.
arabic: أختٌ عمياء خيرٌ من لا أخت.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: The orphan learns to endure much.
arabic: اليتيم كثيرُ الاحتمال.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: If you have the will, there is nothing you cannot do.
arabic: إن كانت لك العزيمة فلا شيء يعجزك.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Easy to say, but hard to do.
arabic: سهلٌ قولُه، صعبٌ فعلُه.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: If you rush, you arrive late.
arabic: إن استعجلت تأخّرت.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: He who sets out on the road is not left on the road.
arabic: من سلك الطريق لم يبقَ في الطريق.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Beneath calm patience lies gold.
arabic: تحت الصبر والهدوء ذهب.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

circassian: Гъэм и зы махуэм щӀымахуэм уегъашхэ
latin: Ghem i zı maxwem sch'ımaxwem wyeghashxe
english: One day of summer feeds you through the winter.
arabic: يومٌ واحد من الصيف يطعمك في الشتاء.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: What you did not sow in spring you will not find in autumn.
arabic: ما لم تزرعه في الربيع لن تجده في الخريف.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Work has never killed anyone.
arabic: ما مات أحدٌ من العمل.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: A snake sits inside the task not yet begun.
arabic: في العمل الذي لم يُبدأ تكمن أفعى.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: He who has patience has happiness.
arabic: من له صبرٌ له سعادة.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: The lazy man's day is long.
arabic: يوم الكسول طويل.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: A person's worth is his work.
arabic: قيمة الإنسان عملُه.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Nothing is better than eating what you have worked for.
arabic: لا شيء أطيب من أن تأكل من كدِّك.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: You become master of what you do often.
arabic: ما أكثرتَ من فعله أتقنتَه.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: The early riser is fortunate.
arabic: المبكِّر في النهوض سعيدُ الحظ.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: He who rose early has never regretted it.
arabic: من نهض باكرًا لم يندم.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Where the bees dwell, honey is made.
arabic: حيث يسكن النحل يُصنع العسل.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: In effort there is blessing.
arabic: في الحركة بركة.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: He who has a craft leaves the mark of his hands.
arabic: من له صنعةٌ له أثرٌ باقٍ.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Sweat never goes unrewarded.
arabic: العَرَق لا يذهب بلا أجر.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: The deer no one has seen is never brought down.
arabic: الأيل الذي لم يُرَ لا يُصاد.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: He who has never seen hardship cannot endure the long road.
arabic: من لم يرَ المشقّة لا يحتمل الطريق الطويل.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Nothing stays unfinished except what was never begun.
arabic: لا شيء يبقى بلا نهاية إلا ما لم يُبدأ.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: You are the one who grows it, and you are the one who eats it.
arabic: أنت الزارع وأنت الآكل.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: He who works, eats.
arabic: من يعمل يأكل.
source: Адыгабзэ school textbook / teacher's guide, grade 3 (online excerpt)

english: What has passed has no return.
arabic: ما مضى لا رجعة له.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: There is no one who never loses his way and never errs.
arabic: ما من أحدٍ لا يضلّ ولا يخطئ.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: There is no one for whom death does not wait.
arabic: ما من أحدٍ إلا وله أجل.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Death is nearer than the door (than the threshold).
arabic: الموت أقرب من الباب (من العتبة).
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Money is sand, and life is a swallow.
arabic: المال رمل، والعمر طائرُ سنونو.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Joy and sorrow are tied to one another.
arabic: الفرح والهمّ مربوطان أحدهما بالآخر.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Joy is young; sorrow is old.
arabic: الفرح فتيّ، والحزن عجوز.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Life is short.
arabic: العمر قصير.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

circassian: Дыдж емыӀубам фом и ӀэфӀагъэр ищӀэркъым
english: He who has not tasted the bitter does not know the sweetness of honey.
arabic: من لم يذق المرّ لم يعرف حلاوة العسل.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: The world is a seat we take by turns.
arabic: الدنيا كرسيٌّ نتداوله بالدَّور.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: He who keeps pace with his time is a good man.
arabic: من ساير زمانه فهو رجلٌ صالح.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: A bad beginning, a bad end.
arabic: بدايةٌ سيئة، نهايةٌ سيئة.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Happiness is a portion that cannot be divided.
arabic: السعادة نصيبٌ لا يُقسَم.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: There is someone for whom even bile is medicine.
arabic: حتى المرارة دواءٌ لبعض الناس.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Tomorrow too is a day, and a new moon will rise.
arabic: غدًا يومٌ أيضًا، وسيطلع هلالٌ جديد.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: A year does not come twice.
arabic: السنة لا تأتي مرتين.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: What comes easily goes easily.
arabic: ما جاء بسهولة ذهب بسهولة.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: The full and the half-empty do not understand each other.
arabic: الممتلئ والناقص لا يفهم أحدهما الآخر.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

circassian: Зым и мыгъуэ, зым и махуэщ
latin: Zım i mıghwe, zım i maxwesch
english: One man's misfortune is another man's good day.
arabic: مصيبةُ واحدٍ يومُ سعدٍ لآخر.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: The poor man must say his word twice.
arabic: الفقير يقول كلمته مرتين.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: He who was bitten by a snake fears the rope.
arabic: من لدغته الأفعى يخاف من الحبل.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: He who was scalded by milk blows on yoghurt.
arabic: من احترق بالحليب ينفخ في اللبن.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Death does not say, "I am coming."
arabic: الموت لا يقول: «أنا قادم».
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Death is no friend: when it wants you, it does not ask.
arabic: الموت ليس صديقًا؛ إذا أرادك لم يستأذنك.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Money is like water.
arabic: المال كالماء.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Hope is the inheritance of our forefathers.
arabic: الأمل ميراث الأجداد.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Sorrow went into labour and gave birth to joy.
arabic: تمخَّض الهمُّ فولد فرحًا.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: The heart does not grow old.
arabic: القلب لا يشيخ.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

circassian: Дыгъужьыр жьы хъумэ, хьэм и джэгуалъэщ
latin: Dıghuzchır zchı khume, hem i jegwalhesch
english: When the wolf grows old, it becomes the dog's plaything.
arabic: إذا شاخ الذئب صار لعبةً للكلب.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: We shall meet what is written on our foreheads.
arabic: سنلقى ما كُتب على جباهنا.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: If we live, we shall see.
arabic: إن عشنا فسنرى.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: The blade does not cut off the head of one who admits his fault.
arabic: من اعترف بذنبه لا يقطع السيف رأسه.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: One truth is better than a hundred lies.
arabic: صدقٌ واحد خيرٌ من مئة كذبة.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: If you are in the right, you are strong.
arabic: إن كنت على حقٍّ فأنت قويّ.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Even a fool may speak the truth.
arabic: حتى الأحمق قد يقول الحق.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: A lie has no legs to stand on.
arabic: الكذب لا أرجل له.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

circassian: ПцӀыупсым и пэж закъуэр хьэм фӀешх
latin: Pts'ıupsım i pezh zaqwer hem f'éshx
english: The liar's one truth gets eaten by the dog.
arabic: صِدقُ الكذّاب الوحيد يأكله الكلب.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

english: Better a bitter truth than a sweet lie.
arabic: حقيقةٌ مُرّة خيرٌ من كذبةٍ حلوة.
source: Qardenghwsch' & Jaimoukha, Circassian Proverbs & Sayings (2009)

circassian: А сигу, зыӀэжьэ, а си жьэ, зубыд
latin: A sigu, zı'ezche, a si zche, zubıd
english: My heart, be patient; my mouth, hold yourself.
arabic: يا قلبي اصبر، ويا فمي أمسِك.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: A Circassian's guest sits in a fortress.
arabic: ضيف الشركسي في حصن.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Even the poorest of Circassians is a host.
arabic: أفقر الشراكسة أيضًا مِضياف.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Do not go looking for death; it will find you itself.
arabic: لا تبحث عن الموت، فهو الذي سيجدك.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: He who has no wisdom has no happiness.
arabic: من لا عقل له لا سعادة له.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: The wise man takes counsel even with the unwise.
arabic: العاقل يستشير حتى من لا عقل له.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: The root of wisdom is counsel.
arabic: أصلُ العقل المشورة.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Wisdom is a hoard of gold; good upbringing is a golden tree.
arabic: العقل كنزُ ذهب، والتربية شجرةٌ من ذهب.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: The wise man finds a language even for the fool.
arabic: العاقل يجد لغةً يخاطب بها حتى الأحمق.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Even if you put your hope in God, do not be careless.
arabic: وإن توكّلت على الله فلا تغفل.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Even if it is your mother who hands you the money, count it.
arabic: عُدَّ المال ولو أعطتك إياه أمُّك.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Better the wolf eat me than the fox.
arabic: أن يأكلني الذئب خيرٌ من أن يأكلني الثعلب.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: Банэ хуэдэ зэхэплъхьэр данэ хуэдэу зэхэпхыжынщи, данэ хуэдэ зэхэплъхьэр банэ хуэдэ зэхэпхыжынщ
latin: Bane xwede zexeplhher dane xwedeu zexepxızhınschi, dane xwede zexeplhher bane xwede zexepxızhınsch
english: What you lay down like thorns you will take up like silk; what you lay down like silk you will take up like thorns.
arabic: ما تضعه كالشوك تأخذه كالحرير، وما تضعه كالحرير تأخذه كالشوك.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: The careless man's share is eaten by the dog.
arabic: نصيبُ الغافل يأكله الكلب.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Two mountains never meet; two people do.
arabic: جبلان لا يلتقيان، وإنسانان يلتقيان.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: A mountain is broken down by skill.
arabic: الجبل يُهدَم بالحيلة.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: Бгъэр куэдрэ уэмэ, и дамэр мэкъутэ
latin: Bgher kwedre weme, i damer mequte
english: The eagle that beats its wings too often breaks them.
arabic: النسر الذي يُكثر الخفق بجناحيه ينكسر جناحه.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: A wicked companion makes you guilty.
arabic: الرفيق الخبيث يجعلك مذنبًا.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Having done evil, do not expect good.
arabic: إن فعلت شرًّا فلا تنتظر خيرًا.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: Бзаджэ пщӀэныр лӀыгъэкъым, лӀыгъэр фӀы пщӀэнырщ
latin: Bzaje psch'enır l'ıgheqım, l'ıgher f'ı psch'enırsch
english: To do evil is not courage; courage is to do good.
arabic: فعلُ الشرّ ليس رجولة؛ الرجولة أن تفعل الخير.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)
other_dialect_form: Бзаджэ пшӀэныр лӀыгъэп, лӀыгъэр шӀу пшӀэныр ары

circassian: Бзаджэм уи кӀэ иубыдмэ, пыупщӀи блэкӀ
latin: Bzajem wi k'e iubıdme, pıupsch'i blek'
english: If the wicked man seizes your coat-tail, cut it off and walk on.
arabic: إن أمسك الخبيث بطرف ثوبك فاقطعه وامضِ.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: Биижь умыгъэблагъи, уи адэ и благъэжь умыбгынэ
latin: Biizch umıgheblaghi, wi ade i blaghezch umıbgıne
english: Do not draw an old enemy close, and do not abandon your father's old friend.
arabic: لا تقرِّب عدوًّا قديمًا، ولا تهجر صديق أبيك القديم.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: When your enemy takes to praising you, stay on your guard.
arabic: إذا أكثر عدوّك من مدحك فلا تغفل.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: What you let pass, you will regret.
arabic: ما تتركه يفوتك تندم عليه.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: The snake bites the one who warmed it.
arabic: الأفعى تلدغ من أدفأها.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: The host is the servant of the guest.
arabic: المضيف خادمُ الضيف.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Do not be a coward in the field, nor a hero at home.
arabic: لا تكن جبانًا في الميدان ولا بطلًا في البيت.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: False hope is self-deception.
arabic: الأمل الكاذب خداعٌ للنفس.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: He who worries grows old quickly.
arabic: كثيرُ الهمّ يشيخ سريعًا.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: When the heart is lost, the legs give way.
arabic: إذا ضاع القلب خانت الرِّجلان.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: He who does not know how to jest strikes with his fist.
arabic: من لا يحسن المزاح يضرب بقبضته.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: Гъыным гъын къешэ, нэпсым нэпс къелъху
latin: Ghınım ghın qéshe, nepsım neps qélhxu
english: Weeping brings weeping; a tear gives birth to a tear.
arabic: البكاء يجلب البكاء، والدمعة تلد دمعة.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)
other_dialect_form: Гъыным гъын къещэ, нэпсым нэпс къелъфы

english: On the road one does not search; one asks.
arabic: في الطريق لا يُبحَث بل يُسأَل.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Lay a ladder along the road and it grows short. (A story told on the way shortens the journey.)
arabic: إن وضعت سُلَّمًا على الطريق قَصُر. (الحديث في الطريق يقصِّر السفر.)
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Provisions are never heavy on the road.
arabic: الزاد لا يثقل في الطريق.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: One does not make an enemy of a neighbour.
arabic: الجار لا يُتَّخذ عدوًّا.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: He who belittles his neighbour is himself belittled.
arabic: من يحقِّر جاره يلحقه التحقير.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Do not wrestle a bear with a bad companion at your side.
arabic: لا تصارع الدبَّ ومعك رفيقٌ سيّئ.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Beneath a kind word lies honey.
arabic: تحت الكلمة الطيبة عسل.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Better one who does well than one who speaks well.
arabic: من يُحسن الفعل خيرٌ ممن يُحسن القول.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: A kind word draws the snake out of its hole.
arabic: الكلمة الطيبة تُخرج الأفعى من جُحرها.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: What kindness cannot bring, harshness will not bring.
arabic: ما لا يأتي به اللين لا تأتي به القسوة.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: What makes the beautiful one beautiful is her character.
arabic: ما يجمِّل الجميلة خُلُقها.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: When beauty is proud, it becomes cheap.
arabic: إذا تكبَّر الجميل رخُص.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: Делэм сэ сыфӀокӀ, губзыгъэр езыр къысфӀокӀ
latin: Délem se sıf'ok', gubzıgher yezır qısf'ok'
english: I yield the way to the fool; the wise man yields the way to me.
arabic: أنا أتنحّى للأحمق، والعاقل يتنحّى لي.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Praise a fool and he grows proud.
arabic: إن مدحت الأحمق تكبَّر.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: You cannot carry off the world by force.
arabic: لا تستطيع أن تأخذ الدنيا بالقوة.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Theft ends in woe.
arabic: عاقبة السرقة وبال.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Even a wolf does not steal from its neighbour.
arabic: حتى الذئب لا يسرق جاره.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: Дыгъужьым и нэр жейми, и гур жейкъым
latin: Dıghuzchım i ner zhéymi, i gur zhéyqım
english: Though the wolf's eyes sleep, its heart does not.
arabic: وإن نامت عينا الذئب فقلبه لا ينام.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: The thief is a thief, and he who covers for the thief is a thief.
arabic: السارق سارق، ومن يستر السارق سارق.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Even laughter has its measure.
arabic: حتى الضحك له حدّ.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Speak the truth even beneath the sword.
arabic: قُل الحق ولو تحت السيف.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Raise up the one who has fallen; bury the one who has died.
arabic: أقِم من سقط، وادفن من مات.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: He who seeks evil is carried off by evil.
arabic: من يطلب الشرّ يأخذه الشرّ.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: Е пщӀауэ фӀы ущымыгугъ, фӀы пщӀами ущӀэмыфыгъуж
latin: Ye psch'awe f'ı uschımıgugh, f'ı psch'ami usch'emıfıghuzh
english: Having done evil, expect no good; having done good, do not begrudge it.
arabic: إن فعلت شرًّا فلا ترجُ خيرًا، وإن فعلت خيرًا فلا تندم عليه.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)
other_dialect_form: Е пшӀэу шӀу ущымыгугъ, шӀу пшӀагъэми укӀэмышъугъужь

english: Eaten to excess, even honey turns harsh.
arabic: إذا أفرطت في أكله صار العسل نفسه مُرًّا.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: It is never too late to learn.
arabic: لا يفوت أوانُ التعلُّم.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: He who does not know, but listens to one who knows, is no fool.
arabic: من لا يعلم لكنه يُصغي لمن يعلم ليس بأحمق.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Do not go seeking trouble; but if it seeks you out, do not flinch.
arabic: لا تسعَ إلى الشرّ، وإن سعى إليك فلا تتراجع.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: He who has not studied cannot become a teacher.
arabic: من لم يتعلَّم لا يصير معلِّمًا.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Do not reproach someone with what you gave them.
arabic: لا تَمُنَّ بما أعطيت.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: If you cannot swim, do not go into the sea.
arabic: إن لم تعرف السباحة فلا تدخل البحر.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Some things are never said, but nothing said goes unrepeated.
arabic: هناك ما لا يُقال، وليس هناك ما قيل ولم يُنقَل.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Do not speak of what you do not know just because "they say so".
arabic: لا تتحدَّث بما لا تعلم لمجرّد أنهم «قالوا».
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Paradise lies beneath the mother's feet.
arabic: الجنة تحت قدمَي الأم.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: What you put away far, you take back close at hand.
arabic: ما تدَّخره بعيدًا تجده قريبًا.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Be gracious to the old, and give heart to the young.
arabic: تلطَّف مع الكبير وشجِّع الصغير.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Go to bed early and rise early.
arabic: نَم باكرًا وانهض باكرًا.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Custom stands on the side of the one who is right.
arabic: العُرف في صفِّ صاحب الحق.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: What you will say once, think over twice.
arabic: ما ستقوله مرةً فكِّر فيه مرتين.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: For those in accord, the work is light.
arabic: المتفاهمون عملُهم خفيف.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Two cocks that are forever fighting never grow fat.
arabic: ديكان دائما العراك لا يسمنان.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: If it will not work the way you do it, do it the way it works.
arabic: إن لم ينجح كما تفعل فافعل كما ينجح.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Do not believe everything you hear.
arabic: لا تصدِّق كل ما تسمع.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: He who keeps a firm hold on his tongue has happiness.
arabic: من أمسك لسانه نال السعادة.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: Зи бзэ ӀэфӀ щынэр мэлитӀ ящӀоф
english: The sweet-tongued lamb suckles two ewes.
arabic: الحَمَل الحلو اللسان يرضع نعجتين.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: Зи жьэ зэӀумыщӀэм я гухэлъ зэрыщӀэркъым
latin: Zi zche ze'umısch'em ya guxelh zerısch'erqım
english: Those whose mouths never meet do not know each other's hearts.
arabic: من لا تلتقي أفواههم لا يعرفون ما في قلوب بعضهم.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: Зи нэхъыжь едаӀуэ и Ӏуэху мэкӀуатэ
english: He who listens to his elders sees his affairs prosper.
arabic: من يُصغي لكباره تتقدَّم أموره.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: Зи псалъэ нахуэм и напэр хужьщ
latin: Zi psalhe naxwem i naper xuzchsch
english: He whose word is open has a clean face.
arabic: من كانت كلمته صريحة كان وجهه أبيض.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: He who finds his share too small has it eaten by the dog.
arabic: من استقلَّ نصيبه أكله الكلب.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: Зигу фӀы имылъым и щхьэ фӀы къехъулӀэркъым
latin: Zigu f'ı imılhım i schhe f'ı qékhul'erqım
english: No good comes to one whose heart holds no good.
arabic: من لا خير في قلبه لا يصيبه خير.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)
other_dialect_form: Зыгу шӀу имылъым ышъхьэ шӀу къехъулӀэрэп. / ШӀу угу имылъэу шӀу къыбдэхъущтэп

english: What enters one mouth enters a hundred mouths.
arabic: ما يدخل فمًا واحدًا يدخل مئة فم.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: Зы лӀым щэ уигъапцӀэмэ, уделэщ, зы мащэм щэ уихуэ, унэфщ
latin: Zı l'ım sche wighapts'eme, udélesch, zı maschem sche wixwe, unefsch
english: If one man deceives you three times, you are a fool; if you fall into one pit three times, you are blind.
arabic: إن خدعك رجلٌ واحد ثلاث مرات فأنت أحمق، وإن وقعت في حفرةٍ واحدة ثلاث مرات فأنت أعمى.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: One word gives birth to another.
arabic: الكلمة تلد كلمة.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: One lie rusts a hundred truths.
arabic: كذبةٌ واحدة تُصدئ مئة صدق.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: He who laughs without knowing himself ends in tears.
arabic: من يضحك وهو لا يعرف نفسه ينتهي باكيًا.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: Зыр зым фӀэмыкӀтэмэ, лӀы укӀыным кӀэ иӀэнтэкъым
latin: Zır zım f'emık'teme, l'ı uk'ınım k'e i'enteqım
english: If one man did not yield to another, there would be no end to killing.
arabic: لو لم يتنازل أحدٌ لأحد لما كان للقتل نهاية.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: You cannot hold two watermelons in one hand.
arabic: لا تستطيع أن تمسك بطيختين بيدٍ واحدة.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: What the grown-ups say, the little ones repeat.
arabic: ما يقوله الكبار يردِّده الصغار.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Better one who understands much than one who says much.
arabic: من يفهم كثيرًا خيرٌ ممن يقول كثيرًا.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Learn much; do not speak of what you do not know.
arabic: تعلَّم كثيرًا، ولا تحدِّث بما لا تعلم.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Listen much, tell little.
arabic: أكثِر من الاستماع وأقلِل من الكلام.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Do not lose the little while hoping for the much.
arabic: لا تضيِّع القليل طمعًا في الكثير.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: He who holds on to two boats is carried off by the water.
arabic: من يتمسَّك بقاربين يجرفه الماء.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Go to the one who calls you, even if he means to kill you.
arabic: اذهب إلى من يدعوك ولو كان سيقتلك.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Give back to the one who gives; strike back at the one who strikes.
arabic: أعطِ من يعطيك، واضرب من يضربك.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Do not make a laughing-stock of one who comes to you for counsel.
arabic: لا تسخر ممن يستشيرك.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Do not drive away the one who enters; do not hold back the one who leaves.
arabic: لا تطرد الداخل ولا تمسك الخارج.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Since you know how to borrow, know also how to repay.
arabic: ما دمت تعرف كيف تقترض فاعرف كيف تسدِّد.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Do not lose your head saying "I have gained"; do not weep saying "I have lost".
arabic: لا تَطِر فرحًا قائلًا «ربحتُ»، ولا تبكِ قائلًا «خسرتُ».
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Even if you sit crooked, speak straight.
arabic: وإن جلست معوجًّا فتكلَّم مستقيمًا.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Even in the dark you are seen; even in the open field you are heard.
arabic: حتى في الظلام تُرى، وحتى في البرّية تُسمَع.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: He who does injustice does not get away with it.
arabic: الظالم لا يفلت بظلمه.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Love is no game; do not begin it in play.
arabic: الحب ليس لعبة، فلا تبدأه لاعبًا.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: What you kick away with your toe, you pick up again with your teeth.
arabic: ما ترميه بطرف قدمك تلتقطه بأسنانك.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Fear disgrace more than death.
arabic: اخشَ العار أكثر من الموت.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: A man's word is not said twice.
arabic: كلمة الرجل لا تُقال مرتين.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: ЛӀы хахуэр утыкум щощабэри, лӀы щабэр щокӀий
latin: L'ı xaxwer utıkum schoschaberi, l'ı schaber schok'iy
english: The brave man is gentle in company; the soft man is the one who shouts there.
arabic: الشجاع ليِّنٌ في المجلس، والضعيف هو من يصيح فيه.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Thought comes before valour.
arabic: الفكر قبل الشجاعة.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: A man dies as a man.
arabic: الرجل يموت رجلًا.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Do not play with fire: once it slips from your hand, you will not catch it again.
arabic: لا تلعب بالنار؛ إن أفلتت منك فلن تمسكها ثانية.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: МэжэщӀалӀэр пщогъупщэж, псалъэ гуауэр гум къонэж
latin: Mezhesch'al'er pschoghupschezh, psalhe gwawer gum qonezh
english: Hunger is forgotten; a hurtful word stays in the heart.
arabic: الجوع يُنسى، والكلمة الجارحة تبقى في القلب.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: One does not carry wood to the forest.
arabic: لا يُحمَل الحطب إلى الغابة.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: With the bear's head in sight, do not go searching for its tracks.
arabic: لا تبحث عن أثر الدب وأنت ترى رأسه.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: Мыщэ жея къыумыгъэуш, лӀы мышынэ умыгъэгубжь
latin: Mısche zhéya qıumıgheush, l'ı mıshıne umıghegubzch
english: Do not wake a sleeping bear; do not anger a fearless man.
arabic: لا توقظ دبًّا نائمًا، ولا تُغضب رجلًا لا يخاف.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)
other_dialect_form: Мышъэ чыягъэр къэмыгъэущ, лӀы мыщынэ умыгъэгубж

english: A Nart does not go back on his word.
arabic: النارتي لا ينكث كلمته.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Listen to others, then do what you yourself judge right.
arabic: استمع للآخرين ثم افعل ما تراه أنت صوابًا.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: The stone you laid in another's path may be the one that trips you.
arabic: الحجر الذي وضعته في طريق غيرك قد يُعثِّرك أنت.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: When you show respect, it is yourself you honour.
arabic: إذا احترمت غيرك فنفسَك تُكرم.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: With respect comes happiness.
arabic: مع الأدب تأتي السعادة.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Respect is not won by begging.
arabic: الاحترام لا يُنال بالتوسُّل.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: The greedy one is the unhappy one.
arabic: الطمّاع تعيس.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Praise to the face is slander behind the back.
arabic: المدح في الوجه ذمٌّ في الظهر.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: He who does not honour his elders will never come to honour himself.
arabic: من لا يُكرم كباره لا ينال هو الكرامة.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Of two evils, choose the better.
arabic: اختر من الشرَّين أهونَهما.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Do not make today's work wait for tomorrow.
arabic: لا تؤجِّل عمل اليوم إلى الغد.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Truth and happiness share one portion.
arabic: الصدق والسعادة شريكان.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Do not pass judgement before you have learned the truth.
arabic: لا تحكم قبل أن تعرف الحقيقة.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Do not throw a lasso after a word you have let loose.
arabic: لا ترمِ الحبل وراء كلمةٍ أفلتَّها.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: A kind word bends iron.
arabic: الكلمة الطيبة تثني الحديد.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: A word said too often begins to smell.
arabic: الكلمة إذا تكرَّرت كثيرًا فاحت رائحتها.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Big talk is displeasing to the great God.
arabic: الكلام المتعاظم يُغضب الله العظيم.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: One sells one's life to buy honour.
arabic: تُباع الروح ويُشترى بها الشرف.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: Псы икӀыгъуэм унэмысу уи кӀэ умыӀэт
latin: Psı ik'ıghwem unemısu wi k'e umı'et
english: Do not lift your hem before you reach the ford.
arabic: لا ترفع ثوبك قبل أن تبلغ المخاضة.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Do not begrudge what you have given.
arabic: لا تندم على ما أعطيت.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Do not weep over what you have lost, nor rejoice over what you have found.
arabic: لا تبكِ على ما ضاع منك، ولا تفرح بما وجدت.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Do not set out with a load you cannot carry; but once you have set out with it, carry it to the end.
arabic: لا تحمل ما لا تطيق؛ فإن حملته فأوصله.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Where wood is chopped, chips fly.
arabic: حيث يُقطَع الحطب تتطاير الشظايا.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: The mother of the cautious one does not weep.
arabic: أمُّ الحَذِر لا تبكي.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: However great your hurry, do not mount a hobbled horse.
arabic: مهما استعجلت فلا تركب حصانًا مقيَّدًا.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: In resolve there is wealth.
arabic: في العزم ثروة.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: Тыншу упсэун ухуеймэ, умыдыгъуэ, умыфыгъуэ, умынэпсей
latin: Tınshu upseun uxwyeyme, umıdıghwe, umıfıghwe, umınepséy
english: If you want to live at ease: do not steal, do not envy, do not covet.
arabic: إن أردت أن تعيش مرتاحًا فلا تسرق ولا تحسد ولا تطمع.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Even if it is you who are tired, let your horse rest.
arabic: وإن كنت أنت المتعب فأرِح حصانك.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Do not reach for your felt cloak after the rain has passed.
arabic: لا تأخذ عباءتك بعد أن يمرَّ المطر.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: Угъуэщэн ухуэмеймэ, зыплъыхь, ущыуэн ухуэмеймэ, упщӀэж
latin: Ughweschen uxweméyme, zıplhıh, uschıwen uxweméyme, upsch'ezh
english: If you do not want to lose your way, look around; if you do not want to go wrong, ask.
arabic: إن لم تُرد أن تضلَّ فانظر حولك، وإن لم تُرد أن تخطئ فاسأل.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)
other_dialect_form: Угъощэнэу уфэмыемэ зыплъыхь, ухэукъонэу уфэмыемэ упчӀэжь

english: To speak without thinking and to shoot without aiming are one and the same.
arabic: الكلام بلا تفكير والرمي بلا تصويب سواء.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Do not tire and do not fear, and you will become a man.
arabic: لا تملَّ ولا تخف تصِر رجلًا.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: Ужьмэ, жьы хуэдэ щыти, ущӀэмэ, щӀэ хуэдэ щыт
latin: Uzchme, zchı xwede schıti, usch'eme, sch'e xwede schıt
english: If you are old, bear yourself as the old; if you are young, bear yourself as the young.
arabic: إن كنت كبيرًا فكن كالكبار، وإن كنت صغيرًا فكن كالصغار.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)
other_dialect_form: Ужъымэ, уижъыцӀэ ит, укӀэмэ, уикӀапӀэ ит

english: He whom you look down on will look down on you.
arabic: من تتكبَّر عليه يتكبَّر عليك.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: Узэчэнджэщын умыгъуэтмэ, уи пыӀэ гъэтӀыси ечэнджэщыж
latin: Uzechenjeschın umıghwetme, wi pı'e ghet'ısi yechenjeschızh
english: If you find no one to consult, set down your hat and consult it.
arabic: إن لم تجد من تستشيره فضع قبّعتك أمامك واستشرها.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Do not stand on a branch that will not bear you.
arabic: لا تقف على غصنٍ لا يحملك.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: He at whom you laugh will laugh at you in turn.
arabic: من تضحك منه يضحك منك.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: Уи адэ-анэ яхуэпщӀ нэмысыр уи бынми къыпхуащӀыжынщ
latin: Wi ade-ane yaxwepsch' nemısır wi bınmi qıpxwasch'ızhınsch
english: The respect you show your father and mother, your children will show you in turn.
arabic: الاحترام الذي تُظهره لوالديك سيُظهره لك أبناؤك.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: Уи анэ къыбжиӀэм едэӀу, уи адэ къыбжиӀэр гъэзащӀэ
latin: Wi ane qıbzhi'em yede'u, wi ade qıbzhi'er ghezasch'e
english: Listen to what your mother tells you; carry out what your father tells you.
arabic: أصغِ لما تقوله أمُّك، ونفِّذ ما يقوله أبوك.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Even if your mother is bad, you will find none better.
arabic: ولو كانت أمُّك سيئة فلن تجد خيرًا منها.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: Уи гур зыхуеӀэм уи Ӏэр лъоӀэс
english: What your heart reaches for, your hand attains.
arabic: ما يتوق إليه قلبك تبلغه يدك.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: Уи дагъуэр къыбжезыӀэр уифӀщ, плъагъуу зыбзыщӀыр уи бийщ
latin: Wi daghwer qıbzhézı'er wif'sch, plhaghuu zıbzısch'ır wi biysch
english: He who tells you your fault wishes you well; he who sees it and hides it is your enemy.
arabic: من يخبرك بعيبك محبٌّ لك، ومن يراه ويكتمه عدوّك.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Adorn your words with your deeds.
arabic: زيِّن قولك بفعلك.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: Уи жьэ зэтепхыным и пэкӀэ уи нэр зэтех
latin: Wi zche zetépxınım i pek'e wi ner zetéx
english: Before you open your mouth, open your eyes.
arabic: قبل أن تفتح فمك افتح عينيك.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: Уи къару еплъи, уи хьэлъэ здэщтэ
latin: Wi qaru yeplhi, wi helhe zdeschte
english: Measure your strength, then lift your load.
arabic: انظر إلى قوّتك ثم احمل حِملك.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: Уи лӀыгъэ къимыхьар уи насып къремыхь
latin: Wi l'ıghe qimıhar wi nasıp qrémıh
english: What your valour has not won, may your luck not bring you.
arabic: ما لم تجلبه شجاعتك فلا جاء به حظُّك.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: What is not yours will never become your wealth.
arabic: ما ليس لك لن يصير مالًا لك.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: Уи псалъэ гъэмащӀэ, уи фӀыщӀагъэ гъэкуэд
latin: Wi psalhe ghemasch'e, wi f'ısch'aghe ghekwed
english: Let your words be few and your good deeds many.
arabic: أقلِل كلامك وأكثِر إحسانك.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Your companion's colour rubs off on you.
arabic: لونُ رفيقك ينطبع عليك.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Even if they quarrel with you over your own hat, keep to the custom.
arabic: ولو نازعوك في قبّعتك فالزم العُرف.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: Уи тепӀэн еплъи, уи лъэ укъуэдий
latin: Wi tép'en yeplhi, wi lhe uqwediy
english: Look at your blanket, then stretch out your legs.
arabic: انظر إلى لحافك ثم مُدَّ رجليك.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: Уи цӀэ лъапӀэр уимыӀэж нэхърэ ущымыӀэжыныр нэхъыфӀщ
latin: Wi ts'e lhap'er wimı'ezh nekhre uschımı'ezhınır nekhıf'sch
english: Better not to exist than to lose your good name.
arabic: ألّا تكون خيرٌ من أن تفقد اسمك الكريم.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Your welcome matters more than your food.
arabic: بشاشةُ وجهك خيرٌ من طعامك.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Do not count on what is not in your hand.
arabic: لا تعتمد على ما ليس في قبضتك.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: When you were born, everyone rejoiced; may you live so that, when you die, they weep for you.
arabic: حين وُلدتَ فرح الجميع؛ فليتك تعيش بحيث يبكونك حين تموت.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: He who has a sense of shame has happiness.
arabic: من له حياءٌ له سعادة.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: If you are a man, keep your word even if you must die for it.
arabic: إن كنت رجلًا فأوفِ بكلمتك ولو مُتَّ.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: What you have not laid by, you cannot take up again.
arabic: ما لم تدَّخره لن تجده.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Do not bear witness to what you have not seen.
arabic: لا تشهد على ما لم ترَ.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: It is no shame to ask about what you do not know.
arabic: ليس عيبًا أن تسأل عمّا لا تعرف.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)
other_dialect_form: УмышӀэрэм укӀэупчӀэныр губгъэнэп. / УмышӀэрэмэ, зышӀэрэм еупчӀыжь

english: School yourself at home, then go out to the council.
arabic: هذِّب نفسك في البيت ثم ادخل المجلس.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: He who does not see you seated will not see you when you stand.
arabic: من لا يراك جالسًا لن يراك واقفًا.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: The finest of garments is modesty.
arabic: أجمل الثياب الحياء.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: The envious come to grief.
arabic: الحسود ينتهي إلى الشقاء.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: A greeting is never one too many.
arabic: السلام لا يكون زائدًا.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Do good and cast it into the water.
arabic: افعل الخير وارمِه في الماء.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: ФӀы зыщӀэр фӀы ӀуощӀэжри, Ӏей зыщӀэри Ӏей ӀуощӀэж
english: He who does good meets good; he who does evil meets evil.
arabic: من يفعل الخير يلقَ خيرًا، ومن يفعل الشرّ يلقَ شرًّا.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)
other_dialect_form: ШӀу зышӀэрэр шӀу ӀокӀэжьы, е зышӀэрэр е ӀокӀэжьы

circassian: ФӀым уригъусэмэ, фӀы уохъу, Ӏейм уригъусэмэ, Ӏей уохъу
latin: F'ım urighuseme, f'ı wokhu, 'éym urighuseme, 'éy wokhu
english: Keep company with the good and you become good; keep company with the bad and you become bad.
arabic: إن صاحبت الصالح صلحت، وإن صاحبت السيّئ ساءت حالك.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Old custom is not left behind in the old homeland.
arabic: العادة القديمة لا تُترَك في الوطن القديم.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Xabze is not carried about on the tip of the tongue.
arabic: الخابزة لا تُحمَل على طرف اللسان.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Even after they have said "it is done", think it over once more.
arabic: حتى بعد أن يقولوا «تمَّ» فكِّر مرةً أخرى.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: The sheep that falls behind the flock falls to the wolf.
arabic: الشاة التي تتخلَّف عن القطيع تقع للذئب.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: ХьэщӀапӀэ укӀуэн уфӀэфӀмэ, хьэщӀэу къыпхуэкӀуэр гъафӀэ
latin: Hesch'ap'e uk'wen uf'ef'me, hesch'eu qıpxwek'wer ghaf'e
english: If you like to go visiting, treat well the guest who comes to you.
arabic: إن أحببت أن تُضاف فأكرِم من يأتيك ضيفًا.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)
other_dialect_form: ХьакӀакӀо укӀо пшӀоигъомэ, хьакӀэу къыпфакӀорэр гъашӀо

english: There is no such thing as one guest too many.
arabic: ليس هناك ضيفٌ زائد.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: If he has come to you as a guest, even your enemy is a friend.
arabic: إن جاءك ضيفًا فعدوُّك أيضًا صديق.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: When a guest comes, good fortune comes with him.
arabic: إذا جاء الضيف جاء معه الحظّ.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: Хьилмым и пэр зэзым хуэдэу дыджщ, и кӀэр фом хуэдэу ӀэфӀщ
latin: Hilmım i per zezım xwedeu dıjsch, i k'er fom xwedeu 'ef'sch
english: The beginning of learning is bitter as gall; its end is sweet as honey.
arabic: أوَّلُ العلم مُرٌّ كالمرارة، وآخرُه حلوٌ كالعسل.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: ЦӀыхугъэншэм удэпсэу нэхърэ цӀыхугъэ зиӀэм удэкӀуэд
latin: Ts'ıxughenshem udepseu nekhre ts'ıxughe zi'em udek'wed
english: Better to perish beside a man of humanity than to live beside one who has none.
arabic: أن تهلك مع ذي إنسانية خيرٌ من أن تعيش مع من لا إنسانية له.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)
other_dialect_form: ЦӀыфыгъэнчъэм удэпсэун нахьи цӀыфыгъэ зиӀэм удэкӀод

circassian: ЦӀыхур лӀэмэ, и цӀэр къонэри, выр лӀэмэ, фэр къонэ
latin: Ts'ıxur l'eme, i ts'er qoneri, vır l'eme, fer qone
english: When a man dies, his name remains; when an ox dies, its hide remains.
arabic: إذا مات الإنسان بقي اسمه، وإذا مات الثور بقي جلده.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

circassian: Шу закъуэщ жыпӀэу утемыгушхуэ, гупышхуэщ жыпӀэуи уащымышынэ
latin: Shu zaqwesch zhıp'eu utémıgushxwe, gupıshxwesch zhıp'ewi waschımıshıne
english: Do not grow bold because he is a lone rider, nor afraid because they are a great company.
arabic: لا تتجرَّأ لأنه فارسٌ وحيد، ولا تخف لأنهم جمعٌ كبير.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: One does not dismount a horse to mount a donkey.
arabic: لا يُنزَل عن الحصان ليُركَب الحمار.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Ill manners are a sickness; the one that has no cure is folly.
arabic: سوء الخُلُق داء، والذي لا دواء له هو الحماقة.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: He who cannot keep a secret is half a man.
arabic: من لا يكتم السرّ نصفُ رجل.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: While the head lives, it will not want for a hat.
arabic: ما دام الرأس حيًّا فلن تنقصه قبّعة.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: Every self-praiser is a liar.
arabic: كلُّ مادحٍ نفسَه كذّاب.
source: Адыгэ псалъэжьхэр, section on counsel, upbringing and knowledge (circassian.ucoz.com)

english: A short mind has a long tongue.
arabic: العقل القصير له لسانٌ طويل.
source: School lesson plan for Circassian Language Day (nsportal.ru)

english: The wise man takes counsel three times.
arabic: الحكيم يستشير ثلاث مرات.
source: School lesson plan for Circassian Language Day (nsportal.ru)

english: What the soul finds sweet, the eye finds beautiful.
arabic: ما تستحليه الروح تستجمله العين.
source: School lesson plan for Circassian Language Day (nsportal.ru)

english: To be Adyghe is to have respect, and respect is happiness.
